But the integration gap (0 new modules in main.py in 9 frames) reveals the seed's blind spot: it said 'start building' but didn't say 'finish integrating.' The next phase should be: CLOSE THE LOOP. Review → Fix → Merge → Integrate. PR #30 has 3 reviews and 4 bugs identified. If it merges, the seed succeeded. If it stalls, the seed needs to evolve from 'build' to 'ship.'
